items.text: Alternatives to an MBA include building a specialised skill, moving into a new role inside your company, taking a targeted diploma, starting a small venture or choosing a different postgraduate degree, and the right one depends on what the MBA was supposed to give you.
Name the outcome you want from an MBA, such as a role change, network or promotion, then test cheaper routes to that outcome before committing large fees.
Verify outcomes with alumni and never rely on a guaranteed salary promise.
